_readme: Ground truth untuk evaluasi ArgosAI: 10 dokumen di eval/pdf-files/ (maks. 10 sumber per notebook).
products : untuk skor ekstraksi. match = semua token harus muncul di (brand_name + product_name), lowercase alfanumerik.
price    : nilai yang dianggap benar; null = harga memang tidak ada. Field hilang = harga tidak dinilai.
currency : kode yang dianggap benar (null boleh).
complete : true = daftar products lengkap, jadi precision bisa dihitung; false = sampel (recall saja).
expect_no_price: true = dokumen tidak memuat harga produk; baris ekstraksi yang punya price = halusinasi.
facts    : fakta terverifikasi untuk pertanyaan uji. evidence = kutipan teks dari PDF (dicek otomatis ada di halaman `page`).
cross_document: fakta yang jawabannya butuh dua dokumen atau lebih (uses = id fakta).
unanswerable: pertanyaan yang jawabannya tidak ada di dokumen mana pun; jawaban benar = mengakui data tidak tersedia, tanpa mengarang.
Dokumen lama (13 PDF) dicadangkan di eval/ground_truth_lama.json.

_readme: Notebook B (eval/extraction-files/, 10 documents): per-field reference for extraction F1 and the reference DB for SQL.
Entity level: extracted rows of the same product (one per section) are merged before scoring.
Field lists = accepted values (normalised: lowercase alphanumeric; prices ±0.5%). null in a list = the field may be empty.
advantages/disadvantages: points = key facts the document states; judged by an LLM (covers ≥1 point, no contradiction).
points [] and optional false = the document states none; any prediction is a false positive.
brand: required wherever the document writes the brand in its text (all documents except the Kia price list, whose brand is only in the logo).

while the extraction prompt was changed, so they no longer measure generalisation.
Sample reference (complete=false): recall and field accuracy; other products are reported only.
code: the product's model/part number (scored against model_code; also identifies the product).
